item.title: Why I’m Low-Key Relieved 'Tell Me Lies' Is Finally Over
item.description: It’s official: Tell Me Lies is over. After four years of emotional chaos, the series took its final bow when the finale aired on February 17, 2026. It’s a day many fans (myself included) both counted down to and quietly dreaded. And now that we’ve all had a minute to process…can I be honest? I’m actually happy it ended. And probably not for the reason you think. Don’t get me wrong, there’s a part of me that didn’t want to let it go. It’s rare for a show to truly pull me in the way this one did.
